subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Area B Personal And Social Life
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does 'soy aficionado al baloncesto' mean?
options: I am a fan of basketball
questions.explain: 'Ser aficionado a' means 'to be a fan of', so this means 'I am a fan of basketball'.

questions.q: Which sentence means “Social media can be addictive”?
options: Las redes sociales pueden estar adictivas
Las redes sociales pueden ser adictivas
Las redes sociales puede ser adictivas
Las redes sociales pueden ser aburridas
questions.explain: “Las redes sociales” = social media and “adictivas” = addictive: “pueden ser adictivas”.

questions.q: What does 'el ocio' mean?
questions.explain: 'El ocio' means 'leisure / free time'; it is a false friend with English 'office' (which is 'la oficina').

questions.q: Which sentence means “The whole family gets together to have dinner”?
options: Toda la familia se reúne para desayunar
Toda la familia se reúne para cenar
Todo la familia se reúne para cenar
Toda la familia se reúne para comer
questions.explain: “Reunirse” = to get together and “cenar” = to have dinner: “Toda la familia se reúne para cenar”.

questions.q: How would you write 'simpático' to describe two girls?
questions.explain: Adjectives agree with the noun: feminine plural takes -as, so two girls are 'simpáticas'.

questions.q: What does “la pantalla” mean?
questions.explain: “La pantalla” means “the screen” of a device.

questions.q: What does “engordar” mean?
questions.explain: “Engordar” means “to put on weight / get fat”; the opposite is “adelgazar”.

questions.q: What does “el villancico” mean?
questions.explain: “El villancico” means “a Christmas carol”.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Social media can be dangerous'?
options: Las redes sociales pueden ser peligrosas
Las redes sociales son siempre divertidas
Los medios sociales puede ser peligroso
Las redes sociales pueden ser seguras
questions.explain: 'Las redes sociales' is feminine plural, so 'peligrosas' agrees; 'pueden ser peligrosas' = 'can be dangerous'.

questions.q: What does “disfrazarse” mean?
questions.explain: “Disfrazarse” means “to dress up / wear a costume”, e.g. at carnival.

questions.q: What does “una película de dibujos animados” mean?
questions.explain: “Dibujos animados” means “cartoons”, so it is “an animated/cartoon film”.

questions.q: What does “quedarse en casa” mean?
questions.explain: “Quedarse” = to stay, so “quedarse en casa” = “to stay at home”.

questions.q: How do you say “You should drink plenty of water”?
questions.explain: “Se debe” = “one should” and “beber” (not “comer”) is used for drinks: “Se debe beber mucha agua”.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to keep fit'?
options: Hago ejercicio porque estoy en forma
Hace ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
Hago ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
questions.explain: 'Mantenerse en forma' = 'to keep fit' and 'para' = 'in order to'; 'hago' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: What does “montar a caballo” mean?
questions.explain: “Montar a caballo” means “to go horse riding”.

questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate my grandmother's birthday'?
options: Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos la Navidad de mi abuela
Celebro el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuelo
questions.explain: 'Celebramos' = 'we celebrate' and 'de mi abuela' = 'my grandmother's', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What does 'el bienestar' mean?
questions.explain: 'El bienestar' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: How do you say “I have a headache”?
questions.explain: “Me duele la cabeza” = “my head hurts / I have a headache”.

questions.q: What does “una entrada” mean (for a concert)?
questions.explain: “Una entrada” means a “ticket” for an event (it can also mean a starter or doorway).

questions.q: What is celebrated in Spain on 'el Día de los Reyes Magos' (6 January)?
options: The Three Kings / Epiphany, when children get presents
questions.explain: 'Los Reyes Magos' are the Three Kings; on 6 January Spanish children traditionally receive their presents.

questions.q: What does “coleccionar sellos” mean?
questions.explain: “Los sellos” here means “stamps”, so “coleccionar sellos” = “to collect stamps”.

questions.q: What does “mi medio hermano” mean?
questions.explain: “Medio hermano” means “half-brother” (one shared parent).
